## Conclusion

No existing artifact is suitable to designate as the authoritative scope and requirements baseline for the proposed web application.

The source set supports a new artifact, but not an immediate baseline:

- The request brief provides the original business need and replacement feature scope.
- The charter and closure report provide historical scope and acceptance evidence.
- The procedures provide historical content and access workflows.
- The web-app delivery plan provides a proposed MVP direction.
- The decision log and platform decision show that the canonical platform baseline still says WordPress.

## Recommended New Artifact

Create a new scope and requirements record after the platform-direction change and scope owner are approved.

Proposed filename: `artifacts/lead-lab-web-app-scope-and-requirements.md`

Proposed minimum content:

- Approved product goal and user groups
- Requirement IDs with source, rationale, priority, owner, and testable outcome
- MVP inclusions and exclusions
- Deliverables and acceptance criteria
- Assumptions, constraints, dependencies, and open questions
- Traceability from requirements to features, work items, and tests
- Approval authority and scope-change route
- Change history linking the WordPress baseline to the approved web-app direction

The filename and location remain proposed. PR-02 is not resolved until the PM confirms the artifact owner, location, and authority to establish the record.
